description: Fit source-only risk mixture of two legal frozen recovery directions and doses. Isolate packet-global versus local chirp-by-band weights.

Verified source-only 24000-step from-scratch U-Net original-loss arm as fixed expert. No target prediction or optimizer.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Both inherited source checkpoint proofs verified against the actual identical source U contract and fixed candidate row. W24 only after both mixtures freeze.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: All ancestors frozen at preregistered source-only steps. No F, TX, source V, practical/trace, target IQ or truth inputs in router training/freeze.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze at 6000 steps. Half-rendered actual mixture must strictly beat direct, archived W24 DURA, outer DURA, original-loss U-Net and matched global weight arm on six scenes, match all five on low urban, and match direct clean. Only pass invokes Full target three shards and independent scoring.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 GPU order 0, 3, 5, 7, 2; two distinct cards with at least 12 GiB free and fewer than eight visible contexts, one fit per card.
execution.stop_rule: Stop dependent phases on wrong role, failed branch gradients/numerics, source baseline mismatch, missing artifacts or prediction mismatch. Preserve artifacts and other jobs.

notes: Hypothesis: the distinct physically realizable corrections of the two locked models can complement each other if the fusion weights vary across received chirps and frequency bands. Scores from the source-only coverage audit are context only; no W24 labels/logits or inferred oracle routes fit this model.

Both arms compute the same raw, DURA half/full, U-Net half/full complex edit candidates. Four non-DC bands by absolute FFT bin 1-8, 9-32, 33-80, 81-192. Router inputs are observed energy, inter-expert and observation-edit complex coherence, outlying noise, observed tracking quality and band position. Softmax creates a convex waveform mixture. The control averages logits across the packet while the candidate keeps local logits. Fixed no-edit DC and copied raw edges. In formal use exactly the mixture; generic half renderer matches mixture, generic full is twice the learned edit for source diagnosis only.

Fit requires source U IQ and the two strict same-contract frozen parents. Draw two independent generic observations per source packet from the established archive with 2 packet identities per batch. At each chirp/band calculate five legal paired waveform risks and train a softmax risk distribution at temperature .20. Combine cross entropy .25 with actual restored outer/inner waveform risks .5 each, clean identity 2 and time complex MSE .25. Expert gradients disabled. 20000 fit U, 500 held U, no calibration. 6000 updates from identical random router initialization.

Freeze both rows before W24. Source panel 300 identical Full packets ×7; direct, original 40000 DURA, 24000 U-Net and outer DURA replay exactly their frozen archive predictions. Candidate/controls fixed before scoring. Qualified candidates only progress to the three predefined Full shards, with no Residual path and independent truth last.
